findings.diagnosis: The baseline epigraph makes a positive claim about what seeking presence as currency does. The shipped one makes two denials and asserts nothing. Neither contains a prohibited mark, so no punctuation rule reached either. CTD-0012 and CTD-0046 have a real interest in what a currency is said to do, and the correct paydown under those items is a bound in the body, not a replacement epigraph presented as the same line.

findings.summary: The definition of the arc, and its three denials, were removed.

evidence.baseline: The developmental arc is not a career ladder. It is not a hierarchy of status or authority. It is a description of how human beings who are genuinely engaged with the architecture tend to develop over time ... The institution's responsibility to the arc is not to engineer development but to provide the conditions under which development becomes possible.

findings.diagnosis: Career ladder and status hierarchy are what a five stage progression looks like to any reader, which is 4.3's retention limb exactly. Not to engineer development but to provide the conditions is the institution's obligation, and it is the sentence that keeps the arc from being a programme people are put through.

openQuestions: The restored epigraph says presence sought as currency makes its holders more present. That is a claim about what the proposed currency does to people, and CTD-0012 and CTD-0046 both bear on currency claims. Restored under tonight's policy and flagged.

The volume-04 voice card was prepared by the same pass that produced the shipped text, and its exemplar anchors and protected lines quote that text rather than the baseline. The card records `Author approved: pending tone, strategy, heading, and overcompression review`. The restoration keeps every line the card protects and otherwise follows the baseline, which means card and source now diverge in wording the card does not name. R-VOICE-BIND requires that the disagreement be raised rather than settled here: the card should be re-derived from whichever text the author approves.

Structural labels were frozen for this pass and none was touched. Every markdown heading, every standalone bold display line, every chapter label, and every all-capital display line is byte identical to its pre-edit state, in the same order, with the same blank-line separators on both sides. A label determines a section id, a section id is a public route, and `publishing/continuity/section-lineage.json` already records this volume's renames and resolves the historical routes. Changing one is a continuity decision and not an editorial one. Only the running prose between labels was restored. Where a baseline label names its section better than the current one, the cost is recorded here and the label is left alone.

regenerationTest.purpose: The rules must reproduce the section from the baseline without consulting the shipped text.

regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. Fourth confirmed epigraph substitution in the volume. All four share a signature: the baseline epigraph makes a claim and the shipped one issues a caution, which is a defensible editorial instinct executed in the one place the standard says not to.
